corrected_conditional_capability_rule.ari_az_team_alias_qualified_for_frozen_v: May be true only if every overall V4 gate passes, all 4 preregistered team_alias_ari targets resolve uniquely, and at least one resolved team_alias_ari target actually selects an NGS candidate whose teamAbbr is AZ while the official roster team is ARI. If no resolved target actually exercises ARI->AZ equivalence, this conditional capability remains false even if V4 otherwise passes.

rationale: The original unopened V4 preregistration could mark alias capability true from four successful Arizona resolutions without proving that any resolution actually required the ARI<->AZ equivalence. Requiring observed exercise prevents an unexercised rule from earning authority.
